meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: RBI bank groups, as on 31 March
meta.coverage: How bad loans move each year: gross and net NPAs at the start, added, recovered or upgraded, written off, and at the end, all banks and by bank group, 2004-05 to 2024-25
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1114 (Movement of NPAs of Scheduled Commercial Banks), bank by bank, summed here to all banks and to bank groups (public: nationalised banks, SBI and its associates; private: old, new and all private banks; small finance banks), ₹ lakh crore; Final where published. The report's unit column is unreliable (it lists SECONDS, LAKH TONNES and the like); values are rupees, which reconcile with report 330's bank-group NPAs.
